name: oracle4_frozen_baseline
purpose: Immutable baseline replay manifest for the Oracle 4.0 research program. All challenger experiments must reference this manifest. The production baseline is the code at code_sha with all flags at the defaults below; parity means bit-for-bit identical baseline decisions when replayed through any new harness with all new flags off.

code.notes: HEAD of oracle4-research == reference commit named in the Oracle 4.0 master prompt. No production file is modified by Phase 0.

environment.credentials: Alpaca PAPER keys present via .env (names inventoried in docs/oracle4_gap_audit.md; values never read). No live-trading credentials are used by any research path.

baseline_flags.comment: Existing research/shadow flags and their effective defaults at code_sha. New ORACLE4_* flags do not exist at this SHA and are introduced only in Phase 7, default OFF.
baseline_flags.ENABLE_ORACLE4_SHADOW: not present at baseline (Phase 7, default off)

data_assets.description: Frozen server extract of the research ledger (sqlite). 14,264 snapshots (2,526 candidate + 11,738 shadow_candidate), 88 underlyings, 2026-11-04T14:53Z to 2026-11-13T20:05Z (~8 exchange sessions). 3,654 events: 779 submitted, 779 fill, 754 exit, 1,342 outcome, 0 cancel, 0 reject.
Research export of all ledger decisions (14,264 lines). Known defect: companion export_groups.jsonl is empty (0 lines); group reconstruction must come from the ledger itself.
Candidate resolution labels (70 lines). Local working-tree copy is modified relative to git; this hash freezes the copy used for Oracle 4.0 research. Never committed per standing instruction.

data_caveats: Outcome provenance is dominated by mark-derived P&L (3,565 mark vs 14 fills-true at freeze time); fills-based booking only began at code_sha.
Zero cancel/reject events exist, so fill-probability calibration must shrink to conservative priors (Phase 6).
~8 sessions of coverage << the pre-registered 60-session / 200-resolved-opportunity promotion gates; all empirical gates therefore start PENDING / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Historical option bid/ask backfill is unavailable; forward quote capture (server cron since 2026-11-15) is the growing fallback.

test_baseline.notes: tests/test_safety.py (directory copy) hangs in this environment and is always ignored; the root-level test_safety.py is collected.

parity_statement: Baseline parity is defined as: replaying the frozen data assets through any new Oracle 4.0 harness with all new flags off reproduces the baseline's decisions and scores bit-for-bit (same selected contracts, same scores, same gates). Verified as a Phase 2 acceptance criterion. No Phase 0 change touches smart_trader.py, exit_manager.py, scheduler, or any production order path.
